title: They shine so brightly.
text: They shine so brightly.. I absolutely love these. They are long and much brighter than I thought they would be. I love how flexible the wire is. It makes it easy to shape and twine around things. The only draw back is that they get easily tangled when your trying to unravel them, no matter how careful you are. I love the little battery switch with included batteries.

product_metadata.title: Brightown 12 Pack Led Fairy Lights Battery Operated String Lights Waterproof Silver Wire 7 Feet 20 Led Firefly Starry Moon Lights for DIY Wedding Party Bedroom Patio Christmas (12 Pack, White)
features: Long battery life: CR2032 batteries included. 48 hours long battery life, longer working time than other's 24 hour fairy string lights

Durable wire and bright bulbs: battery fairy lights are 7 feet in length, made of coated flexible silver wire. Wire is thin, almost invisible to see from distance. 20 mini led bulbs are equipped with big and bright chips, 4 inch spacing between led bulbs, 0.66 feet lead wire between the battery pack and the first light bulb
IP65 waterproof: the light string is IP65 waterproof, could be immersed in water without worry of short circuit. ( Only the string lights is waterproof, the battery pack is not waterproof )
Safe: the starry string lights are low energy consumption, no overheat and remain cool after long hours usage, stay safe to touch
